# Generated Artifacts

This directory contains all artifacts generated from the LinkML schema.

**Do not edit files in this directory** — they are regenerated by `just gen-project`.

## Contents

| Directory | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| [jsonschema/](jsonschema/) | JSON Schema definitions for validation |
| [docs/](docs/) | Markdown documentation for MkDocs |
| [excel/](excel/) | Excel workbook templates |
| [node/](node/) | TypeScript types for Node.js/React |
| [dart/](dart/) | Dart classes for Flutter apps |

## Regenerating

```bash
just gen-project
```
